summary: Strict parent-approval flow was incomplete: websites were block-list based instead of default-deny.
evidence: Unknown domains were only filtered from existing blocked rules; approved grants suppressed blocks but unblocked sites had no request/block path.
fix_plan: Added WebsiteAccessPolicy, hidden default-deny site rules, child prompt flow, and parent dashboard status.
verify_command: Guard.Tests.exe: enforces website default deny requests

summary: AppLocker policy could allow normal apps under Program Files through broad default rules.
evidence: Policy script used New-AppLockerPolicy -AllowWindows without removing broad Program Files allow rules.
fix_plan: Bumped policy schema and removed broad Program Files allow rules while preserving Windows/Guard stability rules.
verify_command: Guard.Tests.exe: builds default-deny AppLocker policy script

summary: Build could fail when Yandex.Disk copy files were auto-included as C# source.
evidence: MSBuild reported duplicate GuardState/MaintenanceMode/ParentCommand definitions from files named copy from LG computer.
fix_plan: Added DefaultItemExcludes for those copy files and restored missing AccountLockdown state property.
